moves.label: Trade: Bradley Beal, Jordan Goodwin, Isaiah Todd, Chris Paul, Landry Shamet and others
moves.description: Bradley Beal, Jordan Goodwin and Isaiah Todd were acquired by the Phoenix Suns in exchange for Chris Paul, Landry Shamet, a Swap 2028 1st round picks, a Swap 2024 1st round picks, a 2024 2nd round pick (PHX own), a 2025 2nd round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2026 1st round picks, a 2026 2nd round pick (PHX own), a 2027 2nd round pick (PHX own), a 2028 2nd round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2030 1st round picks, a 2030 2nd round pick (PHX own) and cash. The draft rights to Jarace Walker, a 2028 2nd round pick (PHX own) and a 2029 2nd round pick (WAS own) were acquired by the Indiana Pacers in exchange for the draft rights to Bilal Coulibaly. Chris Paul, Landry Shamet, the draft rights to Bilal Coulibaly, a Swap 2028 1st round picks, a Swap 2024 1st round picks, a 2024 2nd round pick (PHX own), a 2025 2nd round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2026 1st round picks, a 2026 2nd round pick (PHX own), a 2027 2nd round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2030 1st round picks, a 2030 2nd round pick (PHX own), cash and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Washington Wizards in exchange for Bradley Beal, Jordan Goodwin, Isaiah Todd, the draft rights to Jarace Walker, a 2029 2nd round pick (WAS own) and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: Marcus Smart, Tyus Jones, Marcus Sasser, Kristaps Porzingis, Marcus Sasser and others
moves.description: Marcus Smart was acquired by the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for Tyus Jones, the draft rights to Marcus Sasser and a conditional 2024 1st round pick (GOS own). Kristaps Porzingis, the draft rights to Marcus Sasser and a conditional 2024 1st round pick (GOS own) were acquired by the Boston Celtics in exchange for Danilo Gallinari, Mike Muscala, Marcus Smart and the draft rights to Julian Phillips. Danilo Gallinari, Tyus Jones, Mike Muscala, the draft rights to Julian Phillips and a TPE were acquired by the Washington Wizards in exchange for Kristaps Porzingis and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: Jonas Valanciunas, Sidy Cissoko
moves.description: Jonas Valanciunas and a TPE were acquired by the Sacramento Kings from the Washington Wizards in exchange for: Sidy Cissoko, a conditional 2028 2nd round pick (DEN own), a 2029 2nd round pick (SAC own) and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: Jake LaRavia, Colby Jones, Alex Len, Marvin Bagley III, Johnny Davis and others
moves.description: Jake LaRavia and a TPE were acquired by the Sacramento Kings in exchange for Colby Jones, Alex Len and a 2028 2nd round pick (SAC own). Marvin Bagley III, Johnny Davis, a Least Favorable 2025 2nd round pick, a 2028 2nd round pick (SAC own) and a TPE were acquired by the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for Jake LaRavia, Marcus Smart and a conditional 2025 1st round pick (MEM own). Colby Jones, Alex Len, Marcus Smart, a conditional 2025 1st round pick (MEM own) and a TPE were acquired by the Washington Wizards in exchange for Marvin Bagley III, Johnny Davis, a Least Favorable 2025 2nd round pick and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: Patrick Baldwin, Jr., Delon Wright, Hugo Besson, Jericho Sims, Mathias Lessort and others
moves.description: Patrick Baldwin, Jr. and cash were acquired by the San Antonio Spurs in exchange for a 2026 2nd round pick (UTH own). Delon Wright, the draft rights to Hugo Besson, cash and a TPE were acquired by the New York Knicks in exchange for Jericho Sims and the draft rights to Mathias Lessort. Kyle Kuzma, Jericho Sims, a More Favorable 2025 2nd round pick, a 2026 2nd round pick (UTH own) and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for A.J. Johnson, Khris Middleton, Delon Wright, the draft rights to Hugo Besson, a Swap 2028 1st round picks and cash. A.J. Johnson, Khris Middleton, the draft rights to Mathias Lessort, a Swap 2028 1st round picks, cash and a TPE were acquired by the Washington Wizards in exchange for Patrick Baldwin, Jr., Kyle Kuzma, a More Favorable 2025 2nd round pick and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: Reggie Jackson
moves.description: Reggie Jackson and a Least Favorable 2026 1st round pick were acquired by the Washington Wizards from the Philadelphia Sixers in exchange for: a More Favorable 2027 2nd round pick, a 2028 2nd round pick (GOS own), a More Favorable 2030 2nd round pick, a 2030 2nd round pick (WAS own) and a TPE.

Marvin Bagley III, A.J. moves.label: Trade: John Collins, Santi Aldama, Marcus Sasser, Tarik Biberovic, A.J. Johnson and others
moves.description: A conditional 2030 2nd round pick (DET own) and a TPE were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for John Collins and cash. Santi Aldama, Marcus Sasser and the draft rights to Tarik Biberovic were acquired by the Dallas Mavericks in exchange for A.J. Johnson, Khris Middleton, a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own), a conditional 2030 1st round pick (GOS own) and a 2033 2nd round pick (DAL own). Khris Middleton, a 2033 2nd round pick (DAL own) and a TPE were acquired by the Washington Wizards in exchange for D'Angelo Russell, a 2029 2nd round pick (LAL own), a Swap 2032 2nd round picks, a 2033 2nd round pick (WAS own) and a TPE. Caris LeVert, a 2027 2nd round pick (MIL own) and cash were acquired by the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for Gary Harris and Taurean Prince. A.J. Johnson, D'Angelo Russell, Isaiah Stewart II, a 2029 2nd round pick (LAL own), a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own), a conditional 2030 1st round pick (GOS own), a Swap 2032 2nd round picks and a 2033 2nd round pick (WAS own) were acquired by the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for Santi Aldama, the draft rights to Tarik Biberovic, a 2029 2nd round pick (DET own), a 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own) and a 2032 2nd round pick (DET own). John Collins, Gary Harris, Taurean Prince, a Least Favorable 2027 2nd round pick, a 2029 2nd round pick (DET own), a 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own), a 2032 2nd round pick (DET own) and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Detroit Pistons in exchange for Caris LeVert, Marcus Sasser, Isaiah Stewart II, a Least Favorable 2027 2nd round pick, a 2027 2nd round pick (MIL own) and a conditional 2030 2nd round pick (DET own).

moves.label: Trade: Max Strus, Ismael Kamagate, Peyton Watson, Peyton Watson, Cam Whitmore and others
moves.description: Max Strus was acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for the draft rights to Ismael Kamagate, a 2027 2nd round pick (PHL own) and a TPE. A 2031 1st round pick (CLE own), a 2032 2nd round pick (SAC own) and a TPE were acquired by the Denver Nuggets in exchange for Peyton Watson. Peyton Watson, Cam Whitmore, the draft rights to Ismael Kamagate and a TPE were acquired by the Cleveland Cavaliers in exchange for Dennis Schroder, Max Strus, a 2031 1st round pick (CLE own), a 2032 2nd round pick (SAC own), cash and a TPE. Dennis Schroder and cash were acquired by the Charlotte Hornets in exchange for Tre Mann. Tre Mann, a 2027 2nd round pick (PHL own) and cash were acquired by the Washington Wizards in exchange for Cam Whitmore.
